title: PrairieRx Emergency Supply and Transition Fill Schedule
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit schedule of emergency supplies and transition fills.**

| PrairieRx plan | Emergency supply days | Emergency supplies per pending request per drug | Transition window (calendar days after the pharmacy coverage effective date) | Most days supply of the one transition fill |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrairieRx Dual Wrap | 3 | 1 | 0 (not applicable) | 0 |
| PrairieRx Expansion Adult | 3 | 1 | 90 | 30 |
| PrairieRx Adult | 3 | 1 | 90 | 30 |
| PrairieRx Children | 3 | 1 | 90 | 30 |
| PrairieRx Maternity | 3 | 1 | 90 | 30 |
| PrairieRx Complex Care | 3 | 1 | 90 | 30 |
| PrairieRx Long-Term Care | 3 | 1 | 90 | 31 |

### Schedule notes

- The emergency supply figures are the same on all seven plans: 3 days, and 1 emergency supply per pending request per drug.
- PrairieRx Dual Wrap carries a transition window of 0 days and a transition fill supply of 0 days; the transition columns do not apply to it.
- PrairieRx Long-Term Care is the one plan whose transition fill supply figure is 31 days rather than 30.
